title: Decimals and Rational Numbers
summary: Fractions as decimals that stop or repeat, rational numbers on the number line, and why there is always another one in between.

ib.note: Rational numbers and decimal expansions are MYP 3 Number

cbse.chapter: Ganita Prakash Ch 3: A Peek Beyond the Point
Ganita Prakash Part 2 Ch 4: Another Peek Beyond the Point

objectives: I can convert between fractions and decimals.
I can predict whether a fraction gives a terminating or recurring decimal.
I can find rational numbers between two given rational numbers.
misconceptions: There are no numbers between 1/3 and 1/2 with small denominators, so there are only a few.
